name: Paper and ink
notes: Warm off-white page with a deep ink-blue accent; reads like print. Use accent for links and one CTA.

name: Swiss signal
notes: Neutral grid-friendly greys with a single signal red. Red only on primary action and one typographic moment.

name: Sage studio
notes: Green-tinted neutrals so surfaces feel related to the accent. Suits wellness, gardening, sustainability.

name: Desert rose
notes: Blush page with a raspberry-red accent; avoids the cream plus terracotta default.

name: Cobalt porcelain
notes: Cool blue-grey neutrals with saturated cobalt. Confident without the indigo-violet AI gradient.

name: Citrus market
notes: Yellow accent takes dark text, not white. Use yellow as a fill (buttons, highlights), never as text on the light page.

name: Mint clinic
notes: Teal accent with minty tinted surfaces; reads as care rather than tech.

name: Plum ink
notes: Deep plum as the only accent on pale lilac-grey. Keep it flat; no gradients.

name: Kraft and navy
notes: Brown-paper page with a navy stamp-ink accent; for makers, printers, coffee, bookbinding.

name: High vis
notes: Safety orange on white with near-black text. Orange takes dark text for contrast.

name: Nordic fog
notes: Cool fog greys and a muted fjord blue. Low energy, high polish.

name: Poster blue
notes: Yellow surfaces, black 2px borders, electric blue accent. Border is intentionally full-contrast for a brutalist look.

name: Garden party
notes: Leafy dark text with a burnt-orange accent; cheerful but grown-up.

name: Ocean chart
notes: Chart-paper neutrals with a deep teal accent. Good base for dashboards needing a light theme.

name: Bubblegum
notes: Hot pink accent with dark text on it. Pair with rounded type and chunky radii.

name: Gallery graphite
notes: Near-monochrome: the accent is graphite. Distinction comes from type and spacing, not color.

name: Tomato ledger
notes: Ledger-paper white with a tomato red for highlights and data callouts.

name: Pool tile
notes: Chlorine-blue tints and a clear pool-tile blue; for travel, swim, leisure.

name: Midnight ink
notes: Blue-black base, lifted surfaces, sky-blue accent with dark text on it. Elevation by lightness, not shadow.

name: Carbon amber
notes: Amber indicator-light accent on carbon; evokes hardware and meters.

name: Deep forest
notes: Green-black base with a fresh leaf accent. Tint every neutral toward green.

name: Oxblood night
notes: Red-brown darks with a coral-red accent; restaurant, wine bar, theatre.

name: Cobalt dark
notes: Navy base, periwinkle-cobalt accent. A dark SaaS palette that is not indigo-to-violet.

name: Graphite mono
notes: Pure monochrome; the accent is near-white. Let one image or one headline carry the color.

name: Teal observatory
notes: Deep teal night with a bright cyan-teal accent; for research, climate, astronomy.

name: Velvet orchid
notes: Orchid-pink accent on aubergine. Purple-leaning by design; use flat fills, no glow.

name: Espresso brass
notes: Classic premium pairing; widely used, so earn it with photography and type rather than defaulting to it.

name: Dusk coral
notes: Blue-violet night with a warm coral accent; complementary temperatures give energy without neon.

name: Slate signal
notes: Slate greys with a signal-yellow accent for alerts and primary actions in data-heavy UIs.

name: Night rose
notes: Rose-tinted darks with a soft pink accent; beauty, fragrance, wedding.

name: Terminal phosphor
notes: Phosphor green on green-black. A known dev cliche: use when the brief is literally terminal or retro-computing.
